newsitem.title: USA: DC hires new deputy CFO for finance and revenue.
newsitem.headline: DC hires new deputy CFO for finance and revenue.

text.p: District of Columbia officials said on Thursday they appointed General Accounting Office tax policy expert Natwar Gandhi as the city's new deputy chief financial officer for finance and revenue.
"Today is an important milestone for the District of Columbia," D.C. CFO Anthony Williams said at a joint press briefing with D.C. Mayor Marion Barry.
Gandhi is the fourth and final deputy CFO brought on board to help Williams lift the city out of financial crisis, Williams said.
Ghandi, who is associate director of tax policy and administration at the watchdog agency, will join the D.C. staff fulltime on February 3, Williams said.
He will oversee a revenue collection and management staff of 450 at an annual salary of $111,000 annually, Williams said.
The three other deputies that report to Williams are Thomas Huestis, in charge of finance, Earl Cabbell, who oversees financial operations, and Jalal Greene, in charge of budget and planning.
